title: Novelty per-atom verdicts v1
description: `<out stem>.atom_verdicts.json` beside the `novelty` artifact of `skill novelty analyze` (dokimi.novelty.atom_verdicts): one row per atom the run probed, with the judged verdicts (needed, scaffolding, conflict), the measured paired outcome under each scoring and the content category.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

artifact_ref.description: `artifact.ref` of the `novelty` artifact this file was written beside.

ref_digest.description: `artifact.ref_digest` of the `novelty` artifact this file was written beside: the revision of the text the run measured.

model.description: The answering model, as in the `novelty` artifact.

analysis_digest.description: `sha256:` digest of the canonical JSON of the `novelty` artifact this file was written beside, without `schema_version`, `run_id` and `dokimi_version`: names the one analysis, also when two commands share a `DOKIMI_RUN_ID`.

with_arm.description: The arm the outcomes compare with the baseline arm.

conflicts.description: The conflict pairs the run found, with atom ids; [] when none, or when classification did not run.

needed.description: The value judge's answer; null when the judge gave the atom none (--no-classify, a tier without classification, or an atom the judge did not answer for, also when a detected conflict names it).

scaffolding.description: The value judge's answer; null as for needed.

outcome.description: dokimi.novelty.measure.atom_outcomes under each scoring: the worst paired outcome over the atom's probes; null for an atom with no usable pair.

category.description: dokimi.novelty.classify.categorize; null when classification did not run or gave the atom no verdict.
